card.name: Noun after a higher or lower comparison
card.fires_on: The noun or spacing slot right after a comparative like higher, lower, or less than, or after a spec phrase like 'field of', where a number comes next. Seen in label instructions about sizes, classes, targets and settings.

modes.label: Noun after higher/lower
modes.description: The noun completing a comparison such as higher class, lower targets, higher blends.

modes.label: Gap before a numeric spec
modes.description: The space or unit slot just before a number in a technical condition like magnetic field strength or filter size.

card.plain: It fires on the word or gap right after 'higher', 'lower' or 'field of', just before a number or value is given.
